_about: Hand-edited media for product pages. tools/build.py reads this file on every build. Keys under videos, install_photos and eddy_spots are category slugs (data/<slug>.json). Case studies attach to the pages listed in 'pages' and to every page that lists one of their part numbers.

case_studies.title: Top-to-bottom store retrofit
case_studies.segment: Gas station, convenience store and car wash
case_studies.image_alt: Pic Quik fuel canopy at night after the LED retrofit
stat: stores in the chain now being retrofitted
case_studies.situation: HID gas canopy fixtures were wasting energy and caused a maintenance headache, with bulbs and ballasts constantly being replaced.
case_studies.solution: The gas canopy fixtures were easily retrofitted with the directional, horizontal-mount LED-8090. Ease of install and superior light output immediately led to retrofitting the entire store.
case_studies.result: A brighter, more efficient retail environment that is safer and easier to shop, all while standing out amongst the competition.
case_studies.quote: The overall look of the store and light output after being retrofitted was so impressive… I told my managers to do every location ASAP.
products: Gas canopy and car wash bay
team: PRH Electric and the Pic Quik maintenance team

lbi-65.title: Eddy ran the splash test himself
lbi-65.text: IP65, NSF certified and IK08 tough. The bar passed with flying colors. Eddy is still drying off.

color-palette.title: Color for wet places, too
color-palette.text: LBI Color Palette also comes in an LBI 65 version for wet and NSF applications. Eddy checked. Twice. With a water cannon.

lighting-controls.title: Eddy earned his Silvair sash
lighting-controls.text: Bluetooth mesh sensors that are listed on the DLC NLC QPL, with no extra wiring. He still will not tell anyone the app password.

lbi-g2.title: Click, link, done
lbi-g2.text: Seamless connectors snap bars together end to end. Eddy approves of anything that clicks.
